• Ụlọ akụ gị: Kpọọ nọmba dị n'azụ kaadị ụlọ akụ gị ma ọ bụ nke dị na webụsaịtị ụlọ akụ ahụ
• EFCC (kọọ mpụ gbasara ego): https://www.efcc.gov.ng
• Ngwa EFCC Eagle Eye (kọọ n'ekpugheghị aha): Eagle Eye (Play Store / App Store)
• Ngalaba ndị uwe ojii maka mpụ ịntanetị (NPF-NCCC): https://nccc.npf.gov.ng/ereport

_Ndụmọdụ naanị, ọ bụghị ndụmọdụ ego nke ọkachamara._
body:
Nke a dị ka ụgha. Nwee ndidi na ndị mba ọzọ na-arịọ ego.
1. Ekwela ka i kwụọ onye ọkwọ ụgbọ ala ụgwọ ọ bụla.
2. Jide n'aka na a kwụrụ ụgwọ ahụ site na ngwa ụlọ akụ gị ma ọ bụ USSD.
3. Lelee ego dị na akaụntụ gị tupu i wepụta ihe ọ bụla.
english: My ride-sharing driver sent a screenshot saying that ₦120,000 has been paid, but I haven't seen an alert in my app. He wants me to give him goods now.
reply_english:
This looks like a scam. Be careful with strangers asking for money.
1. Don't pay anything to the driver.
2. Confirm if the payment is made through your own bank app or USSD.
3. Check the amount in your account before releasing any goods.

text: Ọ bụrụ na ụlọ akụ ma ọ bụ app m na-edowe ego daa, ego m ga-efu kpam kpam?
must_advise: NDIC insures deposits by licence type: banks and mobile money operators up to ₦5m, microfinance banks up to ₦2m

reply:

english: If my bank or the app I use to store money fails, will all my money be lost?
reply_english: Your money will not be lost if your bank or app fails because of the protection offered by NDIC up to a certain limit. Always use official apps from the Play Store or App Store and check for licenses on the CBN website before saving with any provider.

label: question
text: Kedu ka m ga-esi chekwaa ego kwa ọnwa? Ana m akpata ihe dị ka ₦90,000.
must_advise: Save a fixed amount first when income arrives
Build an emergency fund in a licensed bank before investing
must_not: Put it in a high-return scheme
reply:
Iji chekwaa ego kwa ọnwa, soro usoro ndia:

1. Na-edekọ ihe na-enweta na mmefu ego gi n'akwụkwọ ma obu jiri ngwa nyere gi aka ka o di njikwa.
2. Kewapụ mmefu dị mkpa (mkpa) dịka ụlọ, nri, njem, na ụgwọ akwụkwọ, na mmefu ndị na-adịghị mkpa (chọrọ).
3. Tọọ ego maka ịchekwa tupu imefu ihe chọrọ.

english: How can I save money each month? I am getting about ₦90,000.
reply_english:
To save money each month, follow these steps:

1. Keep track of your earnings and spending in a notebook or use an app to help you stay organized.
2. Distinguish between essential expenses (needs) like rent, food, transport, and school fees, and non-essential expenses (wants).
3. Set aside some money for savings before spending on wants.

label: question
text: Kedu ka m ga-esi kọọrọ ụlọ akụ m banyere aghụghọ e mere m?
must_advise: Use the bank's official fraud hotline, app or branch and get a complaint reference number
Escalate to the CBN Consumer Protection Department if not resolved
must_not: Report to a social media 'customer care' that contacts you
reply:

Ị nwere ike ịkọ banyere aghụghọ gị na ụlọ akụ gị ozugbo o kwere mee. Na mgbakwunye, ị nwekwara ike kọọ mpụ ego na EFCC na mgbanwe SIM ma ọ bụ telecom fraud na onye na-enye gị netwọkụ na NCC. english: How can I report fraud to my bank?
reply_english: You can report fraud to your bank first as soon as possible. Also, you may report financial crimes to the EFCC and SIM swap or telecom fraud to your network provider and the NCC. Make sure to keep track of dates, amounts, phone numbers, and account numbers used by the scammer.

reply_english:
